title: Calloway's band personnel
summary: He lists the strong players and arrangers in Cab's band, including Cozy Cole, Chu Berry, Milton Hinton and Danny Barker.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So I stay with Cab. Cab (inaudible) a band to compete with those big jazz bands. He just wanted to be a showman. I got the best because I can pay the better, have the better. So they had Cozy Cole. So they had Chu Berry. They got Milton Hinton on the bass, and they got Danny on the guitar.

Danny Barker. They got Jerry Baker on the baritone and clarinet. They had a clarinet, and they played good jazz. So he got a hell of a band, and he got a hold of Chappy Willett and Ike Dickson to start writing for the band. So I got in the band.
